uncertainties: Several central tests exercise renderer behavior through legacy tests/components, tests/hooks, tests/store, and tests/pages paths. They are mapped by imported ownership/name and should be verified against AST imports before relocation.
Storybook files are treated as feature-owned test artifacts under tests/stories. Keep Storybook discovery updated when the mechanical move lands.

Some current source aliases reach @backend from renderer files. This map does not legitimize that dependency; those files are listed in splits so their renderer-facing contract can use preload/IPC adapters.
Global hooks index.ts and reusable timer/media-query hooks remain shared because no single one of the nine renderer features owns them.
